facts.fact: President Ghazouani oversaw the groundbreaking of axis 1 (N'Diago to Ould Yengé, 740 km) of a southern border-zone coverage project, to reach over 241 villages and 200,000 inhabitants through 42 new solar sites and 60 upgraded operator sites, financed by the universal access fund and Huawei, per the telecoms minister.
facts.system: southern border zones communication coverage project

systems.system: southern border zones communication coverage project

MRT.note: Project cost of 797 million MRU is stated as financed by the universal access fund and Huawei, but no budget year from 2024, no statement that digital must be paid at home and no fund account is given.
The document mentions new sites connected to the national fibre network but states no backbone contract, works or service.
No electricity access figure is stated.
